verdict.rationale: The pack documents Treasury APIs for holding funds, outbound payments, and transaction ledgers, and says platforms can build their own controls on outbound money movement. Those are developer building blocks, not a documented agent capability. Nothing shows scoped agent credentials, amount caps, or counterparty allowlists, and nothing shows Stripe documenting agent operation of a Treasury account by name. The general MCP-server probe says nothing about Treasury policy-bounded agent access.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can operate an account within policy — scoped credentials that let it read balances and initiate transfers under amount caps and counterparty allowlists, a use the vendor documents by name
